g.text: The Arch · a choice constrained by gate 3
Concept comparison only. Do not move the gate or build either option without approval and swept-volume proof.
A · Under-deck rib: not shown to fit
B · Outboard / above-deck ribs: study first
Gate stays under deck at current location
Glider is under the deck, not through upper arch
Deck top24; underside23.4; gate top23 → only0.4eu above the declared gate
RECOMMENDATION: preserve gate3; investigate option B, including gate heading and full 3D member footprints.
TRADEOFF: this changes the original “glider through the arch” promise. Jonathan decides the experience.
Alternative: relocate/resize gate and redesign course — separate measured option, not authorized here.
These are diagrammatic elevations. No structural dimensions or clearance acceptance for proposed ribs is claimed.
